system.text:
Those Born Great and Black are marked by distinctive features—tall stature, broad shoulders and deep-hued skin. This is the mantle of hereditary leadership among the Orcs. In order to be a Great One or a Servant, one must be Born to Rule Them All. This trait grants a 1D affiliation among Great and Black Orcs and a 1D infamous reputation among the chattel and the legion.

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Orc lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 316
